package bench

enum JobState
  Waiting
  Running
  Finished
end

struct Job
  Name: String
  State: JobState
  Attempts: Int
end

func newJob(name: String) -> Job
  Job { Name: name, State: Waiting, Attempts: 0 }
end

func advance(job: Job) -> Job
  switch job.State
    case Waiting => Job { Name: job.Name, State: Running, Attempts: job.Attempts }
    case Running => Job { Name: job.Name, State: Finished, Attempts: job.Attempts + 1 }
    case Finished => job
  end
end

func score(limit: Int) -> Int
  var total = 0
  var index = 0
  while index < limit
    total = total + index
    index = index + 1
  end
  total
end

func describe(job: Job) -> String
  switch job.State
    case Waiting => "waiting"
    case Running => "running"
    case Finished => "finished"
  end
end
